messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGE FIRED -> Incident 89012: hosted-inference-5xx-spike (severity: P1)
pagerduty: Alert details: service=hosted-inference, symptom=5xx-rate > 8% for 3m, region=us-west-2, trigger=error-rate-threshold
sam: ack (oncall) - looking
maria: seeing the same on metrics: 5xxs up, p50 latency stable but tails blow up. grafana: https://grafana.company/reports/89012
sam: i don't see the PD SMS. phone shows no notification. i got a slack DM from the bot though.
devon: PD logs show primary didn't acknowledge within 2m, escalated to secondary (sam). PD delivery log: sms->gateway timeout for +1-555-0199 (sam).
ops-runbook-bot: runbook: hosted-inference-5xx-spike -> step 1: check model pods, step 2: verify backend; recommended mitigation: scale fallback pool and switch routing to warm pool.
nana: assigning ana (manager) as manager fallback per policy
pagerduty: Escalation: manager ana paged at +120s (call + SMS).
ana: i just saw the page (mobile DND was on, sorry). joining.
maria: quick check: errors are coming from model-v2 pods hitting OOM-restarts? logs show repeated ML runtime reclaim while attempting to serve kv-cache misses.
sam: i can ssh to node? which cluster
devon: cluster inference-prod-us-west2. pods: model-v2-*. See restart counts high.
sam: scaling replicas up to 10 for model-v2-fallback and enabling degraded-quantized variant. executing:
```
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deploy/model-v2-fallback --replicas=10\kubectl -n inference-prod set image deploy/model-v2-fallback model=redwood/model-v2:q4_1\``` 
maria: also flipping routing weight: route 70%->fallback-pool, 30%->primary for 10m via gateway config
```
POST https://gateway.internal/route-adjust
Body: {"service":"hosted-inference","region":"us-west-2","weights":{"fallback":0.7,"primary":0.3}}
```
sam: did the scale command go through? i see new pods coming up.
devon: new pods Ready=8/10, image pulled. CPU usage still climbing. autoscaler muted due to quota (we hit onboarded GPU quota). open ticket with infra for burst quota.
nana: customer impact? any user-visible errors?
maria: customer telemetry shows increased 5xx on the hosted API keys: ~12% of requests failed for a 14m window. Affected customers ~120 developer accounts, some 3rd-party customers reported errors. adding severity annotation: customer-impact=yes, partial-degradation.
sam: posting status: "We are experiencing degraded inference in us-west-2; mitigation in progress. Routing to fallback pool; engineers investigating." (publishing to status page)
ops-runbook-bot: note: PagerDuty delivery failures observed: SMS gateway returned 504 for sam and manager earlier; recommend adding slack/voice fallback in runbook.
devon: small update: added manual voice call to sam (he answered) — sam confirmed ack at +6m. PD still shows missed SMS for secondary.
maria: mitigation seems to reduce 5xx to ~4% after routing change. still above baseline but acceptable.
sam: holding on further cutover until infra quotas resolved. we should avoid full failover to another region to prevent cold-start latencies.
nana: if 5xx doesn't drop below 2% in 10m, we escalate to cross-region failover.
devon: I've opened an infra request to increase burst quota and a PD support case for the SMS gateway issue (ticket PD-8719).
maria: please capture logs for postmortem: `kubectl logs -n inference-prod model-v2-abc --since=30m` and save to s3://redwood-incident-logs/89012/
sam: saving logs now. uploading to s3. link: https://s3.internal/redwood-incident-logs/89012/model-v2-logs.txt
ana: good. action items: 1) PD vendor support (devon) 2) increase quota & follow infra (devon) 3) runbook update for SMS fallback (maria) 4) postmortem (ana).
ops-runbook-bot: suggested timeline: mitigation->stabilize (15m), incident review (24-48h).
devon: follow-up: enabling PD voice fallback for all oncall rotations; adding Slack fallback in escalation policy (will PR today).
maria: marking incident as Mitigated (partial) in PD. moving to monitoring.
sam: leaving oncall handover notes in the handoff doc: https://docs.internal/oncall/handoffs/1712350001
ana: thanks team. keep updates if anything changes. i'll start a pagerduty bridge in 10m for postmortem prep. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INCIDENT 89012 status changed -> mitigated (partial); closed for active escalation.
